description: Quartzo external capture ingress transport contract. The bridge writes only envelopes/media under _capture_ingress; Quartzo app canonicalizes into normal Journal Entries.

identity.whatsapp_capture_id: wa_ + first 32 lowercase hex chars of sha256('whatsapp\0' + provider_message_id)

free_only_invariants: No external database is canonical state.
No bridge writes final daily note Markdown.
No outbound WhatsApp response is required.
Retries must be idempotent by capture_id and operation_id.
